name: States the game never plays for a player's bro
note: The six gestures other than Flex have no input path in the game: the only caller passing one is ImprovedGestureSystem.DisplayGesture (ImprovedGestureSystem.cs:33-40), which plays only a selection made while open is true (:73-126), and nothing writes open (:186); RocketLib's optional gesture key bindings can trigger them. The dance plays only for units with playerNum < 0 (Map.MakeMooksDance, Map.cs:3233-3255, the one caller of Dance). The sweep can only force these by pinning fields, so base-states.json leaves them out; layer this list after it to sweep them. Bare :NNNN line references in the entries are TestVanDammeAnim.cs; BroBase.cs is named explicitly.

states.name: gesture_salute
states.note: AnimateIdle :3445-3448 (currentGesture != None) -> AnimateGesture :4707-4786, overridden by BroBase.AnimateGesture (BroBase.cs:537-552) which calls the base first. The cell is Min(frame, span - 1) * 32 at (9 + gestureIndex) * 32 (:4785), giving row 9 for Salute. blockMovementForGesture true keeps Update :1164 from clearing the gesture whenever actionState is not Idle or fire or special is set, and AnimateGesture's own end-of-span clear at :4780-4783 from firing.

states.name: gesture_wave
states.note: AnimateIdle :3445-3448 (currentGesture != None) -> AnimateGesture :4707-4786, overridden by BroBase.AnimateGesture (BroBase.cs:537-552) which calls the base first. The cell is Min(frame, span - 1) * 32 at (9 + gestureIndex) * 32 (:4785), giving row 10 for Wave. blockMovementForGesture true keeps Update :1164 from clearing the gesture whenever actionState is not Idle or fire or special is set. This gesture loops by rewinding frame at :4776-4779 once frame exceeds its span; the stepped values stay inside the span so the rewind never fires.

states.name: dancing
states.note: AnimateIdle :3449-3452 needs health > 0 && stunTime > 0 && dancingTime > 0 (and currentGesture None) -> AnimateDancingFrames :4798-4803: dancingFramesSheetPosition.x + frame % dancingFrames on row dancingFramesSheetPosition.y. The base defaults are (15, 14) and 12 frames (:11106, :11110), so a bro that overrides them will address a different block than the expect below.
